_meta.method: level-1/2 sections of load_pdf(engine='auto'); each heading and ~300 chars of its body read against the node definitions of the doc type's mapped section taxonomy; written before any model run on the held-out corpus (same procedure as benchmarks/corpus/section_gold.jsonl, P10)
_meta.junk: canonical null = parser junk or not a section; excluded from accuracy, counted separately
_meta.selection: the held-out set's only 2 research.research_paper docs (ho_023, ho_024); financial.annual_report ho_001 (98 level-1/2 sections; ho_002 has 151); legal.contract ho_013 (ho_014 parses to only 2 sections). Chosen by type and section count only, before any model output was seen.
